surface.name: Cas.Word.Query.run_dup_adjacent
surface.signature: ∀ {α : Type} {A : Cas.Word.Aggregator α}, A.Idem → ∀ (f : Cas.Binding → α) (b : Cas.Binding) (w v : Cas.Word), Cas.Word.Query.run A f (w ++ b :: b :: v) = Cas.Word.Query.run A f (w ++ b :: v)

surface.name: Cas.Word.Query.run_natAgg_count
surface.signature: ∀ (p : Cas.Binding → Bool) (w : Cas.Word), Cas.Word.Query.run Cas.Word.natAgg (fun b => if p b = true then 1 else 0) w = (List.filter p w).length

surface.name: Cas.Word.Query.run_nil
surface.signature: ∀ {α : Type} (A : Cas.Word.Aggregator α) (f : Cas.Binding → α), Cas.Word.Query.run A f [] = A.empty

surface.name: Cas.Word.Query.run_perm
surface.signature: ∀ {α : Type} {A : Cas.Word.Aggregator α}, A.Comm → ∀ (f : Cas.Binding → α) {w v : Cas.Word}, List.Perm w v → Cas.Word.Query.run A f w = Cas.Word.Query.run A f v

surface.name: Cas.Word.Query.run_redelivered
surface.signature: ∀ {α : Type} {A : Cas.Word.Aggregator α}, A.Comm → A.Idem → ∀ (f : Cas.Binding → α) (b : Cas.Binding) (w₁ w₂ w₃ : Cas.Word), Cas.Word.Query.run A f (w₁ ++ b :: (w₂ ++ b :: w₃)) = Cas.Word.Query.run A f (w₁ ++ b :: (w₂ ++ w₃))

surface.name: Cas.Word.Query.run_replay
surface.signature: ∀ {α : Type} {A : Cas.Word.Aggregator α}, A.Idem → ∀ (f : Cas.Binding → α) (w : Cas.Word), Cas.Word.Query.run A f (w ++ w) = Cas.Word.Query.run A f w

surface.name: Cas.Word.Query.run_singleton
surface.signature: ∀ {α : Type} (A : Cas.Word.Aggregator α) (f : Cas.Binding → α) (b : Cas.Binding), Cas.Word.Query.run A f [b] = f b

surface.name: Cas.Word.Query.run_storeAgg
surface.signature: ∀ (w : Cas.Word), Cas.Word.Query.run Cas.Word.storeAgg Cas.Word.singleStore w = w.toStore

surface.name: Cas.Word.Query.run_wordAgg_filter
surface.signature: ∀ (p : Cas.Binding → Bool) (w : Cas.Word), Cas.Word.Query.run Cas.Word.wordAgg (fun b => if p b = true then [b] else []) w = List.filter p w

surface.name: Cas.Word.View.column_eq_ofQuery
surface.signature: ∀ (t : Cas.Grammar.Ty), Cas.Word.View.column t = Cas.Word.View.ofQuery Cas.Word.wordAgg (Cas.Word.columnGen (fun b => Cas.Grammar.Ty.ofTag b.node.tag) t)

surface.name: Cas.Word.View.ext
surface.signature: ∀ {α : Type} {V W : Cas.Word.View α}, V.run = W.run → V.merge = W.merge → V.empty = W.empty → V = W

surface.name: Cas.Word.View.height_eq_ofQuery
surface.signature: ∀ (t : Cas.Grammar.Ty), Cas.Word.View.height t = Cas.Word.View.ofQuery Cas.Word.natAgg (Cas.Word.heightGen t)

surface.name: Cas.Word.View.lastK_not_ofQuery
surface.signature: ∀ (t : Cas.Grammar.Ty) (k : Nat), ¬∃ A f, Cas.Word.View.ofQuery A f = Cas.Word.View.lastK t k

surface.name: Cas.Word.View.ofQuery
surface.signature: {α : Type} → Cas.Word.Aggregator α → (Cas.Binding → α) → Cas.Word.View α

surface.name: Cas.Word.columnBy_eq_run
surface.signature: ∀ {L : Type} [inst : DecidableEq L] (c : Cas.Binding → Option L) (l : L) (w : Cas.Word), Cas.Word.Query.run Cas.Word.wordAgg (Cas.Word.columnGen c l) w = Cas.Word.columnBy c l w

surface.name: Cas.Word.columnGen
surface.signature: {L : Type} → [DecidableEq L] → (Cas.Binding → Option L) → L → Cas.Binding → Cas.Word

surface.name: Cas.Word.column_eq_run
surface.signature: ∀ (t : Cas.Grammar.Ty) (w : Cas.Word), Cas.Word.Query.run Cas.Word.wordAgg (Cas.Word.columnGen (fun b => Cas.Grammar.Ty.ofTag b.node.tag) t) w = Cas.Word.column t w

surface.name: Cas.Word.height_eq_run
surface.signature: ∀ (t : Cas.Grammar.Ty) (w : Cas.Word), Cas.Word.Query.run Cas.Word.natAgg (Cas.Word.heightGen t) w = List.length (Cas.Word.column t w)

surface.name: Cas.Word.unregistered_eq_run
surface.signature: ∀ (w : Cas.Word), Cas.Word.Query.run Cas.Word.wordAgg Cas.Word.unregisteredGen w = w.unregistered

surface.name: Cas.Word.Reach.cases_head
surface.signature: ∀ {w : Cas.Word} {a b : Cas.Addr32}, w.Reach a b → a = b ∨ ∃ c, w.Edge a c ∧ w.Reach c b

surface.name: Cas.Word.Reach.head
surface.signature: ∀ {w : Cas.Word} {a b c : Cas.Addr32}, w.Edge a b → w.Reach b c → w.Reach a c

surface.name: Cas.Word.Reach.single
surface.signature: ∀ {w : Cas.Word} {a b : Cas.Addr32}, w.Edge a b → w.Reach a b

surface.name: Cas.Word.Reach.trans
surface.signature: ∀ {w : Cas.Word} {a b c : Cas.Addr32}, w.Reach a b → w.Reach b c → w.Reach a c

surface.name: Cas.Word.decidableReach
surface.signature: {w : Cas.Word} → w.wf = true → (a b : Cas.Addr32) → Decidable (w.Reach a b)

surface.name: Cas.Word.edgeB_iff
surface.signature: ∀ {w : Cas.Word} {a b : Cas.Addr32}, w.edgeB a b = true ↔ w.Edge a b

surface.name: Cas.Word.edge_mono
surface.signature: ∀ {w : Cas.Word} (v : Cas.Word) {a b : Cas.Addr32}, w.Edge a b → (w ++ v).Edge a b

surface.name: Cas.Word.firstIndex_append_of_isSome
surface.signature: ∀ {w : Cas.Word} {b : Cas.Addr32}, (w.find b).isSome = true → ∀ (v : Cas.Word), (w ++ v).firstIndex b = w.firstIndex b

surface.name: Cas.Word.firstIndex_le_length
surface.signature: ∀ (w : Cas.Word) (b : Cas.Addr32), w.firstIndex b ≤ List.length w

surface.name: Cas.Word.firstIndex_lt_length
surface.signature: ∀ {w : Cas.Word} {b : Cas.Addr32}, (w.find b).isSome = true → w.firstIndex b < List.length w

surface.name: Cas.Word.firstIndex_lt_of_take
surface.signature: ∀ {w : Cas.Word} {b : Cas.Addr32} {k : Nat}, (Cas.Word.find (List.take k w) b).isSome = true → w.firstIndex b < k

surface.name: Cas.Word.instDecidableEdge
surface.signature: (w : Cas.Word) → (a b : Cas.Addr32) → Decidable (w.Edge a b)

surface.name: Cas.Word.mem_succs_iff
surface.signature: ∀ {w : Cas.Word} {a c : Cas.Addr32}, c ∈ w.succs a ↔ w.Edge a c

surface.name: Cas.Word.occurrence_two_cycle
surface.signature: ∃ w a b, w.wf = true ∧ a ≠ b ∧ w.edgeOccurrence a b ∧ w.edgeOccurrence b a

surface.name: Cas.Word.reachB_complete
surface.signature: ∀ {w : Cas.Word}, w.wf = true → ∀ {a b : Cas.Addr32}, w.Reach a b → w.reachB a b = true

surface.name: Cas.Word.reachB_iff
surface.signature: ∀ {w : Cas.Word}, w.wf = true → ∀ {a b : Cas.Addr32}, w.reachB a b = true ↔ w.Reach a b

surface.name: Cas.Word.reachB_sound
surface.signature: ∀ {w : Cas.Word} {a b : Cas.Addr32}, w.reachB a b = true → w.Reach a b

surface.name: Cas.Word.reachIn_complete
surface.signature: ∀ {w : Cas.Word}, w.wf = true → ∀ {b : Cas.Addr32} (k : Nat) {a : Cas.Addr32}, w.Reach a b → w.firstIndex a ≤ k → w.reachIn b k a = true

surface.name: Cas.Word.reachIn_self
surface.signature: ∀ (w : Cas.Word) (b : Cas.Addr32) (k : Nat), w.reachIn b k b = true

surface.name: Cas.Word.reachIn_sound
surface.signature: ∀ {w : Cas.Word} {b : Cas.Addr32} (k : Nat) (a : Cas.Addr32), w.reachIn b k a = true → w.Reach a b

surface.name: Cas.Word.reach_acyclic
surface.signature: ∀ {w : Cas.Word}, w.wf = true → ∀ {a b : Cas.Addr32}, w.Reach a b → w.Reach b a → a = b

surface.name: Cas.Word.reach_index
surface.signature: ∀ {w : Cas.Word}, w.wf = true → ∀ {a b : Cas.Addr32}, w.Reach a b → a = b ∨ w.firstIndex b < w.firstIndex a

surface.name: Cas.Word.reach_mono
surface.signature: ∀ {w : Cas.Word} (v : Cas.Word) {a b : Cas.Addr32}, w.Reach a b → (w ++ v).Reach a b

surface.name: Cas.Word.wfFrom_refs_prefix
surface.signature: ∀ (w prior : Cas.Word), prior.wfFrom w = true → ∀ {a : Cas.Addr32} {n : Cas.Node}, w.find a = some n → ∀ {r : Cas.Ref}, r ∈ n.refs → (prior ++ List.take (w.firstIndex a) w).resolvesIn r = true

surface.name: Cas.Word.wf_edge_index
surface.signature: ∀ {w : Cas.Word}, w.wf = true → ∀ {a b : Cas.Addr32}, w.Edge a b → w.firstIndex b < w.firstIndex a

surface.name: Cas.Word.wf_refs_prefix
surface.signature: ∀ {w : Cas.Word}, w.wf = true → ∀ {a : Cas.Addr32} {n : Cas.Node}, w.find a = some n → ∀ {r : Cas.Ref}, r ∈ n.refs → Cas.Word.resolvesIn (List.take (w.firstIndex a) w) r = true

surface.name: Cas.Word.View.merge
surface.signature: {α : Type} → Cas.Word.View α → α → α → α

surface.name: Cas.Word.View.prod
surface.signature: {α β : Type} → Cas.Word.View α → Cas.Word.View β → Cas.Word.View (α × β)

surface.name: Cas.Word.View.run_append
surface.signature: ∀ {α : Type} (self : Cas.Word.View α) (w v : Cas.Word), self.run (w ++ v) = self.merge (self.run w) (self.run v)

surface.name: Cas.Word.lastK
surface.signature: {α : Type} → Nat → List α → List α

surface.name: Cas.Word.lastK_append
surface.signature: ∀ {α : Type} (k : Nat) (x y : List α), Cas.Word.lastK k (x ++ y) = Cas.Word.lastK k (Cas.Word.lastK k x ++ Cas.Word.lastK k y)

surface.name: Cas.Word.lastK_append_eq
surface.signature: ∀ {α : Type} (k : Nat) (x y : List α), Cas.Word.lastK k (x ++ y) = Cas.Word.lastK (k - y.length) x ++ Cas.Word.lastK k y

surface.name: Cas.Word.lastK_assoc
surface.signature: ∀ {α : Type} (k : Nat) (x y z : List α), Cas.Word.lastK k (Cas.Word.lastK k (x ++ y) ++ z) = Cas.Word.lastK k (x ++ Cas.Word.lastK k (y ++ z))

surface.name: Cas.Word.lastK_idem
surface.signature: ∀ {α : Type} (k : Nat) (l : List α), Cas.Word.lastK k (Cas.Word.lastK k l) = Cas.Word.lastK k l

surface.name: Cas.Word.lastK_lastK
surface.signature: ∀ {α : Type} {j k : Nat}, j ≤ k → ∀ (l : List α), Cas.Word.lastK j (Cas.Word.lastK k l) = Cas.Word.lastK j l

surface.name: Cas.Word.lastK_left
surface.signature: ∀ {α : Type} (k : Nat) (x y : List α), Cas.Word.lastK k (Cas.Word.lastK k x ++ y) = Cas.Word.lastK k (x ++ y)

surface.name: Cas.Word.lastK_length
surface.signature: ∀ {α : Type} (k : Nat) (l : List α), (Cas.Word.lastK k l).length = min k l.length

surface.name: Cas.Word.lastK_not_comm
surface.signature: ∀ {α : Type} {x y : α}, x ≠ y → Cas.Word.lastK 1 ([x] ++ [y]) ≠ Cas.Word.lastK 1 ([y] ++ [x])

surface.name: Cas.Word.lastK_of_length_le
surface.signature: ∀ {α : Type} {k : Nat} {l : List α}, l.length ≤ k → Cas.Word.lastK k l = l

surface.name: Cas.Word.lastK_right
surface.signature: ∀ {α : Type} (k : Nat) (x y : List α), Cas.Word.lastK k (x ++ Cas.Word.lastK k y) = Cas.Word.lastK k (x ++ y)

surface.name: Cas.Word.find_append_of_none
surface.signature: ∀ {w : Cas.Word} {a : Cas.Addr32} (v : Cas.Word), w.find a = none → (w ++ v).find a = v.find a

surface.name: Cas.Word.find_append_of_some
surface.signature: ∀ {w : Cas.Word} {a : Cas.Addr32} {n : Cas.Node} (v : Cas.Word), w.find a = some n → (w ++ v).find a = some n

surface.name: Cas.Word.find_isSome_of_mem
surface.signature: ∀ {w : Cas.Word} {a : Cas.Addr32} {n : Cas.Node}, { address := a, node := n } ∈ w → (w.find a).isSome = true

surface.name: Cas.Word.find_mem
surface.signature: ∀ {w : Cas.Word} {a : Cas.Addr32} {n : Cas.Node}, w.find a = some n → { address := a, node := n } ∈ w

surface.name: Cas.Word.resolvesIn_iff
surface.signature: ∀ {w : Cas.Word} {r : Cas.Ref}, w.resolvesIn r = true ↔ ∃ m, w.find r.addr = some m ∧ m.tag = r.expectedTag

surface.name: Cas.Word.resolvesIn_mono
surface.signature: ∀ {w : Cas.Word} (v : Cas.Word) {r : Cas.Ref}, w.resolvesIn r = true → (w ++ v).resolvesIn r = true

surface.name: Cas.Word.toStore_append_congr
surface.signature: ∀ {w w' : Cas.Word}, w.toStore = w'.toStore → ∀ (v : Cas.Word), (w ++ v).toStore = (w' ++ v).toStore

surface.name: Cas.Word.toStore_append_shadowed
surface.signature: ∀ {w : Cas.Word} {a : Cas.Addr32}, (w.find a).isSome = true → ∀ (m : Cas.Node), (w ++ [{ address := a, node := m }]).toStore = w.toStore

surface.name: Cas.Word.toStore_snoc
surface.signature: ∀ {w : Cas.Word} {a : Cas.Addr32} (n : Cas.Node), w.find a = none → (w ++ [{ address := a, node := n }]).toStore = w.toStore.set a n

surface.name: Cas.Word.wfFrom_append
surface.signature: ∀ (prior x y : Cas.Word), prior.wfFrom (x ++ y) = (prior.wfFrom x && (prior ++ x).wfFrom y)

surface.name: Cas.Word.wfFrom_resolves
surface.signature: ∀ {prior rest : Cas.Word}, (∀ (a : Cas.Addr32) (n : Cas.Node), prior.find a = some n → ∀ (r : Cas.Ref), r ∈ n.refs → prior.resolvesIn r = true) → prior.wfFrom rest = true → ∀ (a : Cas.Addr32) (n : Cas.Node), (prior ++ rest).find a = some n → ∀ (r : Cas.Ref), r ∈ n.refs → (prior ++ rest).resolvesIn r = true

surface.name: Cas.Word.wf_snoc
surface.signature: ∀ {w : Cas.Word} {a : Cas.Addr32} {n : Cas.Node}, w.wf = true → (∀ (r : Cas.Ref), r ∈ n.refs → w.resolvesIn r = true) → (w ++ [{ address := a, node := n }]).wf = true

surface.name: Cas.Lang.handle_step_agree
surface.signature: ∀ (H : Cas.Bytes → Cas.Addr32) {op : Cas.Lang.CasSig.Op} {w πacc w₁ πacc₁ πA πA₁ : Cas.Word} {ansP ansV : Cas.Lang.CasSig.Ans op}, Cas.Lang.HonestWord H w → (Cas.Lang.proveHandler H).handle op (w, πacc) = Except.ok (ansP, w₁, πacc₁) → (Cas.Lang.verifyHandler H).handle op πA = Except.ok (ansV, πA₁) → Cas.Lang.HonestWord H w₁ ∧ ∃ π₀, πA = π₀ ++ πA₁ ∧ (ansV = ansP ∧ Cas.Lang.proofNodes πacc₁ = Cas.Lang.proofNodes πacc ++ Cas.Lang.proofNodes π₀ ∨ ∃ bs bs', bs ≠ bs' ∧ H bs = H bs')

surface.name: Cas.Lang.honestWord_find
surface.signature: ∀ (H : Cas.Bytes → Cas.Addr32) {w : Cas.Word} {a : Cas.Addr32} {n : Cas.Node}, Cas.Lang.HonestWord H w → w.find a = some n → ∃ h, Cas.addr H ⟨n, h⟩ = a

surface.name: Cas.Lang.honestWord_snoc
surface.signature: ∀ (H : Cas.Bytes → Cas.Addr32) {w : Cas.Word} {a : Cas.Addr32} {n : Cas.Node}, Cas.Lang.HonestWord H w → ∀ (h : n.WF), Cas.addr H ⟨n, h⟩ = a → Cas.Lang.HonestWord H (w ++ [{ address := a, node := n }])

surface.name: Cas.Lang.interpret_agree_or_collision
surface.signature: ∀ (H : Cas.Bytes → Cas.Addr32) {A : Type} (p : Cas.Lang.Prog Cas.Lang.CasSig A) {w πacc w' πP πA π' : Cas.Word} {aP aV : A}, Cas.Lang.HonestWord H w → Cas.Lang.interpret (Cas.Lang.proveHandler H) p (w, πacc) = Except.ok (aP, w', πP) → Cas.Lang.interpret (Cas.Lang.verifyHandler H) p πA = Except.ok (aV, π') → ∃ π₀, πA = π₀ ++ π' ∧ (aV = aP ∧ Cas.Lang.proofNodes πP = Cas.Lang.proofNodes πacc ++ Cas.Lang.proofNodes π₀ ∨ ∃ bs bs', bs ≠ bs' ∧ H bs = H bs')

surface.name: Cas.Lang.interpret_prove_honest
surface.signature: ∀ (H : Cas.Bytes → Cas.Addr32) {A : Type} (p : Cas.Lang.Prog Cas.Lang.CasSig A) {w πacc w' πP : Cas.Word} {a : A}, Cas.Lang.HonestWord H w → Cas.Lang.interpret (Cas.Lang.proveHandler H) p (w, πacc) = Except.ok (a, w', πP) → Cas.Lang.HonestWord H w'

surface.name: Cas.Lang.interpret_prove_verify
surface.signature: ∀ (H : Cas.Bytes → Cas.Addr32) {A : Type} (p : Cas.Lang.Prog Cas.Lang.CasSig A) {w πacc w' πP : Cas.Word} {a : A} (rest : Cas.Word), Cas.Lang.HonestWord H w → Cas.Lang.interpret (Cas.Lang.proveHandler H) p (w, πacc) = Except.ok (a, w', πP) → ∃ πe, πP = πacc ++ πe ∧ Cas.Lang.interpret (Cas.Lang.verifyHandler H) p (πe ++ rest) = Except.ok (a, rest)

surface.name: Cas.Lang.interpret_pure_state
surface.signature: ∀ {A σ : Type} (h : Cas.Lang.Handler Cas.Lang.CasSig (StateT σ (Except Cas.Lang.Refusal))) (a : A) (s : σ), Cas.Lang.interpret h (Cas.Lang.Prog.pure a) s = Except.ok (a, s)

surface.name: Cas.Lang.interpret_vis_state
surface.signature:
∀ {A σ : Type} (h : Cas.Lang.Handler Cas.Lang.CasSig (StateT σ (Except Cas.Lang.Refusal))) (op : Cas.Lang.CasSig.Op) (k : Cas.Lang.CasSig.Ans op → Cas.Lang.Prog Cas.Lang.CasSig A) (s : σ),
  Cas.Lang.interpret h (Cas.Lang.Prog.vis op k) s =
    match h.handle op s with
    | Except.ok (ans, s') => Cas.Lang.interpret h (k ans) s'
    | Except.error r => Except.error r

surface.name: Cas.Lang.proofNodes_append
surface.signature: ∀ (π π' : Cas.Word), Cas.Lang.proofNodes (π ++ π') = Cas.Lang.proofNodes π ++ Cas.Lang.proofNodes π'

surface.name: Cas.Lang.proofNodes_cons
surface.signature: ∀ (b : Cas.Binding) (π : Cas.Word), Cas.Lang.proofNodes (b :: π) = b.node :: Cas.Lang.proofNodes π

surface.name: Cas.Lang.proveHandler_honest
surface.signature: ∀ (H : Cas.Bytes → Cas.Addr32) (op : Cas.Lang.CasSig.Op) {w πacc w' πacc' : Cas.Word} {ans : Cas.Lang.CasSig.Ans op}, Cas.Lang.HonestWord H w → (Cas.Lang.proveHandler H).handle op (w, πacc) = Except.ok (ans, w', πacc') → Cas.Lang.HonestWord H w'

surface.name: Cas.Lang.proveHandler_store_agree
surface.signature: ∀ (H : Cas.Bytes → Cas.Addr32) (op : Cas.Lang.CasSig.Op) (w π : Cas.Word), Except.map (fun r => (r.fst, r.snd.fst)) ((Cas.Lang.proveHandler H).handle op (w, π)) = (Cas.Lang.referenceHandler H).handle op w

surface.name: Cas.Lang.prove_load_clause
surface.signature: ∀ (H : Cas.Bytes → Cas.Addr32) {a : Cas.Addr32} {w πacc w' πacc' : Cas.Word} {n : Cas.Node}, (Cas.Lang.proveHandler H).handle (Cas.Lang.CasE.load a) (w, πacc) = Except.ok (n, w', πacc') → w.find a = some n ∧ w' = w ∧ πacc' = πacc ++ [{ address := a, node := n }]

surface.name: Cas.Lang.prove_put_answer
surface.signature: ∀ (H : Cas.Bytes → Cas.Addr32) {n : Cas.Node} {w πacc w' πacc' : Cas.Word} {a : Cas.Addr32}, (Cas.Lang.proveHandler H).handle (Cas.Lang.CasE.put n) (w, πacc) = Except.ok (a, w', πacc') → ∃ hn, a = Cas.addr H ⟨n, hn⟩ ∧ πacc' = πacc

surface.name: Cas.Lang.referenceHandler_honest
surface.signature: ∀ (H : Cas.Bytes → Cas.Addr32) (op : Cas.Lang.CasSig.Op) {w w' : Cas.Word} {ans : Cas.Lang.CasSig.Ans op}, Cas.Lang.HonestWord H w → (Cas.Lang.referenceHandler H).handle op w = Except.ok (ans, w') → Cas.Lang.HonestWord H w'

surface.name: Cas.Lang.verify_handle_prefix
surface.signature: ∀ (H : Cas.Bytes → Cas.Addr32) {op : Cas.Lang.CasSig.Op} {π π' : Cas.Word} {ans : Cas.Lang.CasSig.Ans op}, (Cas.Lang.verifyHandler H).handle op π = Except.ok (ans, π') → ∃ π₀, π = π₀ ++ π'

surface.name: Cas.Lang.verify_load_accept
surface.signature: ∀ (H : Cas.Bytes → Cas.Addr32) {a : Cas.Addr32} {π rest : Cas.Word} {m : Cas.Node}, (Cas.Lang.verifyHandler H).handle (Cas.Lang.CasE.load a) π = Except.ok (m, rest) → (∃ dec, π = { address := dec, node := m } :: rest) ∧ ∃ hm, Cas.addr H ⟨m, hm⟩ = a

surface.name: Cas.Lang.verify_load_or_collision
surface.signature: ∀ (H : Cas.Bytes → Cas.Addr32) {w π rest : Cas.Word} {a : Cas.Addr32} {m n : Cas.Node}, Cas.Lang.HonestWord H w → w.find a = some n → (Cas.Lang.verifyHandler H).handle (Cas.Lang.CasE.load a) π = Except.ok (m, rest) → (∃ dec, π = { address := dec, node := m } :: rest) ∧ (m = n ∨ Cas.encodeNode m ≠ Cas.encodeNode n ∧ H (Cas.encodeNode m) = H (Cas.encodeNode n))

surface.name: Cas.Lang.verify_put_answer
surface.signature: ∀ (H : Cas.Bytes → Cas.Addr32) {n : Cas.Node} {π π' : Cas.Word} {a : Cas.Addr32}, (Cas.Lang.verifyHandler H).handle (Cas.Lang.CasE.put n) π = Except.ok (a, π') → ∃ hn, a = Cas.addr H ⟨n, hn⟩ ∧ π' = π

surface.name: Cas.Lang.verify_put_clause
surface.signature: ∀ (H : Cas.Bytes → Cas.Addr32) {n : Cas.Node} (hn : n.WF) (π : Cas.Word), (Cas.Lang.verifyHandler H).handle (Cas.Lang.CasE.put n) π = Except.ok (Cas.addr H ⟨n, hn⟩, π)

surface.name: Cas.Lang.verify_run_prefix
surface.signature: ∀ (H : Cas.Bytes → Cas.Addr32) {A : Type} (p : Cas.Lang.Prog Cas.Lang.CasSig A) {πA π' : Cas.Word} {a : A}, Cas.Lang.interpret (Cas.Lang.verifyHandler H) p πA = Except.ok (a, π') → ∃ π₀, πA = π₀ ++ π'

surface.name: Cas.Lang.whole_run_correctness
surface.signature: ∀ (H : Cas.Bytes → Cas.Addr32) {A : Type} (p : Cas.Lang.Prog Cas.Lang.CasSig A) {w w' πP : Cas.Word} {a : A} (rest : Cas.Word), Cas.Lang.HonestWord H w → Cas.Lang.interpret (Cas.Lang.proveHandler H) p (w, []) = Except.ok (a, w', πP) → Cas.Lang.interpret (Cas.Lang.verifyHandler H) p (πP ++ rest) = Except.ok (a, rest)

surface.name: Cas.Lang.whole_run_security
surface.signature: ∀ (H : Cas.Bytes → Cas.Addr32) {A : Type} (p : Cas.Lang.Prog Cas.Lang.CasSig A) {w w' πP πA π' : Cas.Word} {aP aV : A}, Cas.Lang.HonestWord H w → Cas.Lang.interpret (Cas.Lang.proveHandler H) p (w, []) = Except.ok (aP, w', πP) → Cas.Lang.interpret (Cas.Lang.verifyHandler H) p πA = Except.ok (aV, π') → ∃ π₀, πA = π₀ ++ π' ∧ (aV = aP ∧ Cas.Lang.proofNodes π₀ = Cas.Lang.proofNodes πP ∨ ∃ bs bs', bs ≠ bs' ∧ H bs = H bs')

  Cas.Lang.interpretRef H (Cas.Lang.Prog.vis op k) w =
    match (Cas.Lang.referenceHandler H).handle op w with
    | Except.ok (ans, w') => Cas.Lang.interpretRef H (k ans) w'
    | Except.error r => Except.error r

surface.name: Cas.Lang.interpret_bind
surface.signature:
∀ {M : Type → Type u_1} {S : Cas.Lang.Sig} {A B : Type} [inst : Monad M] [LawfulMonad M] (h : Cas.Lang.Handler S M) (p : Cas.Lang.Prog S A) (f : A → Cas.Lang.Prog S B),
  Cas.Lang.interpret h (p.bind f) = do
    let a ← Cas.Lang.interpret h p
    Cas.Lang.interpret h (f a)

surface.name: Cas.Lang.run_interpretRef_agree
surface.signature: ∀ (H : Cas.Bytes → Cas.Addr32) {A : Type} (p : Cas.Lang.Prog Cas.Lang.CasSig A) (w : Cas.Word), ∃ fuel, ∀ (f : Nat), fuel ≤ f → (∀ (a : A) (w' : Cas.Word), Cas.Lang.run H f p w = (Cas.Lang.Status.done a, w') ↔ Cas.Lang.interpretRef H p w = Except.ok (a, w')) ∧ ∀ (r : Cas.Lang.Refusal), (∃ w', Cas.Lang.run H f p w = (Cas.Lang.Status.refused r, w')) ↔ Cas.Lang.interpretRef H p w = Except.error r

surface.name: Cas.Lang.run_of_interpretRef
surface.signature:
∀ (H : Cas.Bytes → Cas.Addr32) {A : Type} (p : Cas.Lang.Prog Cas.Lang.CasSig A) (w : Cas.Word),
  ∃ fuel,
    ∀ (f : Nat),
      fuel ≤ f →
        match Cas.Lang.interpretRef H p w with
        | Except.ok (a, w') => Cas.Lang.run H f p w = (Cas.Lang.Status.done a, w')
        | Except.error r => ∃ w', Cas.Lang.run H f p w = (Cas.Lang.Status.refused r, w')

  Cas.Lang.step H (Cas.Lang.Prog.vis op k) w =
    match (Cas.Lang.referenceHandler H).handle op w with
    | Except.ok (ans, w') => (Cas.Lang.Status.running (k ans), w')
    | Except.error r => (Cas.Lang.Status.refused r, w)
